create_VonMises_distribution: create a von Mises circular distribution with specified loc and concentration parameters
sample_VonMises: sample from a von Mises distribution with given loc and concentration values
compute_VonMises_log_prob: compute log probability of a value under a von Mises distribution
get_VonMises_mean: get the circular mean of a von Mises distribution from its loc parameter
calculate_VonMises_variance: calculate the circular variance of a von Mises distribution from its concentration parameter
